messages:
leah: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Recording + slides here: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/177200 (recording) and https://redwood.example.com/slides/2026-q1.pdf :white_check_mark:
leah: TL;DR: Dedicated GA moved ~2 weeks to allow a kernel/perf soak; Private pilot starts Apr 6; hiring plan updated; Product will share Optimize prioritization doc by EOD Friday.
mike: appreciate the links. can we get a short changelog on the Dedicated delay?
leah: short version — regression seen in quantized path on A100 when KV cache hit rate low. infra + eng-runtime rolled a fix but want a canary run across peak traffic before GA.
priya: who owns the canary and what does success look like?
leah: eng-runtime (@mike) to run canary next Tue 9am PT; target: p95 latency within 10% of baseline, no increased error rate for 48h.
mike: noted, will post canary runbook in #eng-runtime and ping here when scheduled.
jordan: on hiring — will People Ops share the updated role list and interview rubric? we had a few questions in the Q&A about IC vs EM hires.
kevin: I'll post the hiring doc by EOD today. link will include headcount, role priorities, and EM vs IC guidance.
sam: quick product question — Optimize "auto-batching suggestions" were mentioned. timeline?
leah: Product intends to land the first optimizer recommendations (batching + cache hints) as an experimental beta in May. full rollout Q3 depending on early evals.
priya: will there be opt-in telemetry for the beta? want to ensure customer privacy controls.
jordan: +1 — we need a short privacy summary for customers.
leah: yes — opt-in, anonymized metrics only, optional for Dedicated/Private. Security will publish a short FAQ.
kevin: created a follow-up checklist (will drop links):
- Hiring doc (kevin) — EOD today
- Canary runbook + schedule (mike) — Mon/Tue
- Optimize prioritization doc (product) — Fri EOD
- Security privacy FAQ for beta (security) — next Wed
- All-hands recording + slides (leah) — posted (see above)
ops-bot: Notice: canary pipeline triggered for canary-id: c-2026-04-07 by @mike (this is an automated confirmation).
priya: thanks all. small ask: can we add a single-line note to the slides about the Dedicated timing shift? product ops/legal often grab slides for partners.
leah: good call — updated slide 6 with a 1-sentence note; new slides link above.
mike: I'll follow up in #eng-runtime with the runbook and a link to the canary dashboard once set up.
jordan: thanks — if anyone has follow-ups not covered here, DM me or drop in #all-hands-followups.
leah: closing this thread for actions; will reopen if any of the owners hit blockers. :raised_hands:
